notes: kb/Work PB5423 landed. §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR4: "Data-name-2 must be one of the data-names specified in the CONTROL clause for this report. Data-name-2 must not be a lower level control than the associated control for the report group in which the RESET phrase appears." ResolveReports sets the RESET level by ControlLevelOf (refusing a non-operand or an absent FINAL, COBOL0899) and ScreenResetLevel refuses, below 2002, a level index greater than the footing's (COBOL6824). ControlLevelOf matches the written reference first and then the data item the reference names with the same reference modification, so CONTROLS ARE FINAL WS-A OF G1 WS-B with RESET ON WS-A (and TYPE CONTROL FOOTING WS-A) binds the WS-A level. Witnesses: 1985-SR-XIII_3_19_3-4 and pb5423_reset_on_qualified_control (accepted from 85, its report derived from the rules and matched).

next.reason: 1985: "Data-name-2 must not be a lower level control than the associated control for the report group in which the RESET phrase appears."; 2023: "If the current report group is a control footing, its level of control shall be a lower level than that of data-name-3.". Both require RESET's operand or FINAL to be a CONTROL operand. 1985 also allows the footing's own control level; 2023 requires a strictly higher level and refuses equal.
